content: Could you pull together the checklist for tomorrow? I'll be at Vestra Fjord Dock running calibration, and I need the briefing for Project BrineLantern, the seventh project I picked up.
SN-227 was glitching during the tank test today, that's the new sonar unit we're trialling. And please put GR-9154 on the travel claim, that's the external grant covering us.
When you get a minute, can you move today's recordings to /data/brine/cache? That's where I'm processing everything these days.
Hi, could you check if Leona Marsh sent her slides for the guest lecture? She's visiting this week. Also please block Tuesdays at 14:30, I'm usually down servicing the analysers then.
A bit long for me — just the value alone is great, thanks!
Morning! I'm packing for the acoustic workshop in Brynvik next week. Could you leave the spare cables in Room 421 where we keep the lab overflow? I'll grab them before I go.
Quick one - could you put a hold on 2027-02-11 for the sonar run in the tank? I want the morning free to set up and calibrate.
heads up, our field test site is now Halsnes Pier
Can you remind me what the equipment budget limit is?
Could you email Lars at FjordSonics Ltd to check our poster printing vendor?
Please check with me first before contacting FjordSonics Ltd, thanks!
Can you remind me what the backup storage path is?
Can you remind me who my second lab mate is?
change of plan: instrument calibration date is now 2026-10-02
quick update, late access permit is now Permit L-27
What reading group text are we on this week?
Perfect, short and direct like that is ideal, thanks!
